quote: Les probabilités dénombrables et leurs applications arithmétiques (Enumerable Probabilities and Their Arithmetic Applications)
note: The question about π being normal is inseparable from Borel's 1909 foundational work establishing the formal definition of normal numbers and conjecturing that all irrational algebraic numbers (including π) should be normal. Earlier informal observations existed (e.g., De Morgan in the 1800s), but Borel's 1909 paper formalized both the concept and the question.
